id: title:adamleithp:add staff ui feedback widget that posts to slack

review.reason: The chunk includes the complete implementation of an internal feedback widget, including the frontend UI, a screenshot capture utility, backend API definitions, and a feature flag. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
